Definition: Whether the system enables consumer payments to merchants and businesses for goods and services, including retail purchases, bill payments, e-commerce, and subscription services.
Comments: Merchant payments exist via mobile money ecosystems and Visa Pay’s features (pay merchants/online payments via virtual cards), indicating P2B capability. Definition: Whether national data protection or privacy legislation exists and explicitly covers payment transaction data, including provisions on data collection, storage, sharing, retention, and user rights over their payment data.
Comments: DR Congo’s “Digital Code” (Ordonnance-Loi No. 23/010 of 13 March 2023) includes general personal data protection provisions that cover processing of payment and billing data; a dedicated payment-data-specific regime was not evidenced. [DLA Piper Data Protection Laws (DRC)](https://www.dlapiperdataprotection.com/index.html?t=law&c=CD);[Digital Watch Observatory summary](https://dig.watch/resource/democratic-republic-of-the-congos-digital-code)
